contract.input: Existing /command-inspect: draft:<string> alone defaults to draft preview; explicit view:preview is equivalent. Exactly one of name/draft. Reject forged types, duplicate fields, unknown options, absent input and over-bound arguments before storage.
contract.render: Four existing placeholders only, invocation context, single-pass replacement, literal malformed/capitalized braces and nested allowed keys preserve baseline semantics. Sample arguments never interpolate. Unknown/args placeholders and expanded overflow privately refuse with a correction; no command execution or extra HTTP lookup.
contract.response: Trusted first line: Draft preview — not saved or published. Same body escaping as saved preview, empty allowed_mentions, no mutation controls, one private callback with optional one original-response edit. Total <=2000 UTF-16 units; framing-only truncation must be explicit, raw expansion overflow is not partial success.
contract.effects: Bound SQL socket catches attempted stored-command reads, writes, audits, trigger matching or execution claims even if errors are swallowed. Full REST transcript excludes publication/channel/DM/follow-up traffic. Repeated/closed-pool previews work. Real DB snapshots preserve disabled and foreign rows and all audits; first subsequent prefix delivers, replay/actor cooldown retain their original behavior.
contract.controls: Unchanged staff/automation/foreign-scope refusals plus saved summary/template/preview, ordinary invocation/edit/disable tests remain the controls. A saved lookup outage still produces the original availability reply; a draft does not depend on storage.

handoff: Builder incorporates this exact branch commit and manifest. Never edit the protected file. Return test corrections to its author. Builder owns implementation, help/reference, full GREEN, independent exact-head review and automatic squash merge. Test-author execution evidence is recorded separately; this manifest does not claim a compile or behavior RED.
